name: Level_2 - Task_10
description: Simulate a stepped temperature ramp for bulk Aluminum to validate thermostat equipartition. Start with a conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Aluminum (a = 4.05 Å) expanded into a 3 × 3 × 3 supercell. Use the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as the calculator. Conduct molecular dynamics simulations in the canonical (NVT) ensemble using a Langevin thermostat with a 1.0 fs timestep and a friction coefficient of 0.01 fs⁻¹. Initialize velocities for 300 K. Sequentially ramp the target temperature from 300 K to 900 K in increments of 100 K. At each temperature plateau, equilibrate the system for 4,000 steps, then run 1,000 production steps. Save the atomic configurations every production step during the production phase of each temperature plateau into an ASE trajectory file. Return a JSON dictionary mapping each temperature integer (in K) to the absolute file path of its corresponding production trajectory file. Save momenta, potential energy and forces from the MACE calculator in every trajectory frame. Set each frame's atoms.info fields step (cumulative MD step), time_fs (step times 1.0 fs), thermostat ("Langevin"), and model ("MACE-MP-0"). The initial frame at step zero (or the start of production) is optional; include the final step. Also store friction_fs = 0.01 in atoms.info.
submission_format: absolute path to json file containing a dictionary mapping each temperature integer (in K) to the absolute file path of its corresponding trajectory file (eg. {'300': '/path/to/300K.traj', '400': '/path/to/400K.traj', ...})
